offering_description.value: Publishes news, business information and books, and runs online property listing platforms. It sells subscriptions and advertising to readers, advertisers and businesses worldwide, and its publishing units sell books through retailers and online stores. Its news and information brands are produced by newsrooms and data teams, while its property platforms sell listings and advertising to agents and home seekers.

primary_products.value: newspapers; business news and data; digital news subscriptions; books; property listing portals

primary_services.value: advertising services; data and risk information services; real estate listing services

customer_segment.value: B2C: news and book readers, home buyers, renters and sellers; B2B: advertisers, real estate agents, brokers, financial professionals, corporate risk teams

end_markets.value: media and publishing; real estate; financial services; advertising; education

revenue_model.value: subscription: digital and print news subscriptions for readers and professionals; advertising: display and digital advertising across news and property sites; product sales: print newspapers, books and e-books sold to readers; service fees: data, information and risk services sold to businesses; commissions or management fees: listing fees paid by real estate agents and brokers
revenue_model.category: subscription; advertising; product sales; service fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and publishes newspaper, magazine and book brands sold to readers; service provider: provides news reporting and business information to subscribers and advertisers; software / platform: operates online property listing platforms connecting agents and home seekers
value_chain_position.category: brand owner; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: United States, Australia, United Kingdom and other English-speaking markets, plus international news and book readers

specialization.value: diversified: news and information, digital real estate, book publishing, and regional newspapers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: advertising and data sales teams selling to businesses and agencies; online: news websites, apps and property portals accessed directly by users; third-party retail: bookstores and online retailers selling published titles; partners / resellers: news syndication and data partners distributing content to third parties
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; online; third-party retail; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: media ownership and content rules, data privacy laws, and real estate advertising regulations across markets

notes: Foxtel and other divested businesses are excluded; facet details reflect the company's current structure as best known.
